description: Reconcile and read one media dispatch receipt by ID. Completed images include a native image preview, original media link and Playground URL; display the native image content when supported. Pass waitSeconds (up to 25) to have the server wait for the job to finish (completed, failed, or needs_reconciliation) before answering; retry_after_seconds is null once it has settled. Safe to poll after the run completes or the client disconnects.

dispatchId.description: Dispatch receipt ID returned by generation or media_jobs_list; reuse it to check the same job.

projectId.description: ID of the Playground project chosen for this task; obtain it from project creation, an explicit project link or current context.

waitSeconds.description: Maximum seconds to wait for new events or a job update; prefer long polling over repeated immediate requests. Optional long poll: wait up to this many seconds (0–25, default 0) on the server for a change before returning.

name: playground_media_job_get
title: Get a Playground media job
